coreMemory.english: v. to express, represent, or have a particular meaning；v. to intend or plan to do something；v. to have importance or a particular result for someone
coreMemory.structure: mean a lot to /miːn ə ˈlɑt ˈtuː/（对……意义重大）；mean that /miːn ˈðæt/（意味着……）；mean to do /miːn ˈtuː ˈduː/（打算做）；what do you mean /ˈwʌt ˈduː ˈjuː miːn/（你是什么意思）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ can to mean → ✅ can mean；❌ all means → ✅ by all means

commonErrors.note: 情态动词 can 后面直接接 mean 的原形，不加 to。
在“by all means”这个常用搭配中，介词 by 负责连接后面的对象或范围，不能省略或随意换成其他介词。

coreMemory.directAntonym: misrepresent /mɪˌsrɛprəˈzɛnt/（不如实地叙述；不称职地代表）
coreMemory.example: Your support means a lot to me.
coreMemory.exampleChinese: 你的支持对我意义重大。

meanings.english: to express, represent, or have a particular meaning
meanings.example: A red light usually means that you should stop.
meanings.translation: 红灯通常意味着你应该停下。

meanings.english: to intend or plan to do something
meanings.example: I meant to call you yesterday, but I forgot.
meanings.translation: 我昨天本来打算给你打电话，但忘了。

meanings.english: to have importance or a particular result for someone
meanings.example: Your encouragement means a lot to me.
meanings.translation: 你的鼓励对我意义重大。

synonyms.difference: signify 侧重“象征；预示；要紧；重要”。对应的常用英文义是 “to express or have a particular meaning”。mean 在本卡搭配“mean a lot to someone”中表达“意思是”；换词时要同时检查宾语和介词。

antonyms.chinese: 不如实地叙述；不称职地代表
antonyms.usage: 在“意思是”这个义项下，misrepresent（不如实地叙述；不称职地代表）与 mean 形成对比。对应的常用英文义是 “opposite of mean”。只在这个明确义项和句型中对比，不把两个词的所有用法都视为相反。

derivatives.note: meaning 是 mean 的常用词族形式；作 n. / adj. 时表示“意义；含义；目的；意图”。
meaningful 是 mean 的常用词族形式；作 adj. 时表示“意味深长的”。

confusables.difference: meaning 表示“意义；含义；目的”；mean 在本卡核心搭配“mean a lot to someone”中表示“意思是”。答题时要根据句意和完整结构区分，不只看拼写或中文近义。
